blocks.title: Business pitch
blocks.text: A business pitch is a short presentation explaining your business idea: what the idea is, who the customers are and why it will work.

For a juice shop: the idea is fresh, healthy, affordable juices; the customers are health-conscious people in the neighbourhood; it will work because there are no juice shops nearby and people are becoming more health-conscious. The book notes that companies such as Apple and Google began with simple pitches to win support and investment (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: A successful business pitch should be (MCQ 6)?

items: Pitch: the idea, the customers, why it will work.
